ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: reeve
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Walks the fields every morning, decides what goes in the ground and when, and is the first to see blight or a frost coming.

duties.li: Everyone brings in a little more from every harvest.
The reeve sows and harvests faster, and gets more from each plant.
Opens once the colony has four people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} walked the fields the same afternoon, and came back with a list.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the soil here is better than it looks, and means to prove it.
{PAWN_nameDef} has already changed the planting order twice.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: peacemaker
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Hears out quarrels before they turn into feuds, and sits people down together until they can stand to look at each other.

duties.li: Every rivalry between colonists cools a little each day.
Now and then the peacemaker sits the worst-feuding pair down together, and the rivalry eases a good deal.
The peacemaker is more persuasive, and keeps a cooler head.
Opens once the colony has five people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has already had two quiet words with two different people, and it isn't even dinner.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the door is always open, and has propped it open with a stone to prove it.
The first thing {PAWN_nameDef} did was ask who isn't speaking to whom.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: keeper of days
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Keeps the calendar and the customs: remembers what day it is and what it means, and sees that the colony's days are kept properly.

duties.li: Every council custom and calendar day the colony keeps leaves everyone a small good memory of a day done properly.
The keeper of days carries more weight in conversation.
Opens once the colony has six people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has started a new page in the calendar, and written the date at the top in very careful letters.
{PAWN_nameDef} already knows how many days it is until the next one worth keeping.
{PAWN_nameDef} asked everyone for their birthdays before the votes were even counted.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: herdmaster
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Looks after the colony's animals: the herd, the pens, the milking and the shearing, and the half-wild ones nobody else can get near.

duties.li: Everyone gets a little more milk, wool and eggs from the animals.
The herdmaster tames and trains animals more easily, and gets more from them.
Opens once the colony has six people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} went straight to the pens to tell the animals.
{PAWN_nameDef} has named every animal in the colony by supper, including the ones that already had names.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the herd voted too, and it was unanimous.
